name: mod-void-wanderers-multiplayer
title: Void Wanderers is played through its own new-game menu from the multiplayer picker and lobby

runtime_files.write:
DataModule
	ModuleName = Scripted Activity Saves
	AddGlobalScript = GlobalScript
		PresetName = VW Scene Observer
		ScriptPath = UserSavedGames.rte/VWSceneObserver.lua
		LuaClassName = VWSceneObserver

DataModule
	ModuleName = Scripted Activity Saves
	AddGlobalScript = GlobalScript
		PresetName = VW Scene Observer
		ScriptPath = UserSavedGames.rte/VWSceneObserver.lua
		LuaClassName = VWSceneObserver

checklist.what: The host selects the installed Void Wanderers activity in the real multiplayer picker.
events: combo_select ComboHostActivity Void Wanderers - VoidWanderers.rte PASS

checklist.what: The multiplayer landing opens before hosting or joining.
checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.what: The activity, scene, player count and port are configured.
checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.what: The host opens the Seats options page.
checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.what: The host opens the Rules options page.
checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.what: The host reopens the live lobby options.
checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.what: Start becomes enabled after the remote player readies, then launches the match.
checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.what: The finished match returns to its live lobby.
checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.what: The mod starts a new campaign and answers the local player through at least 1800 further ship updates.
checklist.assert: the whole committed-frame window plus the own scene checker: visible mod menu, new-game transition, ship, player responses and every tick hash

checklist.what: Pause shows the multiplayer rows; End Match is available only to the host.
checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.what: Match Options shows the rules and the host-only Repair action.
checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.what: The multiplayer landing opens before hosting or joining.
checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.what: The joiner connects and sees the shared lobby.
checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.what: Match Details opens with Apply disabled on the client.
checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.what: The client leaves the completed match lobby and returns to Landing.
checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.what: The finished match returns to its live lobby.
checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.what: The mod starts a new campaign and answers the local player through at least 1800 further ship updates.
checklist.assert: the whole committed-frame window plus the own scene checker: visible mod menu, new-game transition, ship, player responses and every tick hash

checklist.what: Pause shows the multiplayer rows; End Match is available only to the host.
checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.what: Match Options shows the rules and the host-only Repair action.
checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.what: The host presses End Match and both peers return to the lobby.
checklist.assert: recorded menu/probe assertions in this marked interval

checklist.what: The client lobby names the adopted Void Wanderers activity and its own scene.

extension_note: The real activity-picker multiplayer leg complements the single and direct-pair runs of mod-void-wanderers.
